Name: Auto Tool Swap and Return
Author: soda5cm
Description:
[size=5][b]Auto Tool Swap & Return[/b][/size]

Walking around with your sword and hitting a rock? [b]Your farmer automatically uses the pickaxe (or axe) for that hit and switches right back to the sword.[/b] No more scrolling through the hotbar every few seconds in the mines or on the farm.

[b]Available in English and Russian.[/b]

[size=4][b]How it works[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Hit a [b]stone or tree[/b] with a sword, scythe, any other tool or an empty hand.[/*]
[*]The farmer swings with the [b]pickaxe[/b] (stones) or the [b]axe[/b] (trees) — then your previous item is back in your hands.[/*]
[*][b]Hold the button[/b] to keep mining the same rock or chopping the same tree; when you release it or the target is gone, you are back to your weapon.[/*]
[*]The target is the exact tile your farmer is about to hit (works with mouse and gamepad).[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Why it's different[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Switches back automatically[/b] after the hit — your sword is ready when a slime jumps at you.[/*]
[*][b]Tools don't have to be in the hotbar.[/b] The pickaxe and axe are taken from anywhere in your backpack, so the hotbar stays free for food, bombs and seeds.[/*]
[*][b]The hotbar never changes.[/b] The selection frame stays on your sword, nothing flickers.[/*]
[*][b]Combat-safe.[/b] If a monster is nearby (4 tiles by default), nothing is swapped and you hit with your weapon.[/*]
[*]Uses your [b]best[/b] pickaxe/axe if you carry several.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]What counts as a target[/b][/size]
[b]Axe:[/b] trees, saplings, stumps, twigs, large stumps (copper axe+) and large hardwood logs (steel axe+).

[b]Pickaxe:[/b] stones, ore nodes (copper, iron, gold, iridium, radioactive), gem nodes, mystic stones, bone and volcano nodes, boulders (steel pickaxe+) and meteorites (gold pickaxe+).

[b]Never touched:[/b] fruit trees and trees with a tapper. Soil, grass and water are ignored. If your tool isn't strong enough for a big log or boulder, it simply isn't swapped.

If you're holding seeds, food, bombs or other items, nothing is swapped, so planting and eating work as usual.

[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
Option — Default
On/off key — F8
Axe for trees — on
Pickaxe for stones — on
Don't swap near monsters (tiles, 0 = always swap) — 4

Everything can be changed in [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (optional) or in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font].

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Works in single-player and multiplayer (only for the player who has it installed). Don't use it together with other auto tool swap mods — they would fight over your tool.

Bugs or ideas? Leave a comment!

My other mods: [b]Bundle Highlighter & Item Encyclopedia[/b] and [b]Lazy Farmer[/b].

[i]Also on CurseForge.[/i]
